test_title: PYST 24: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 16 Mar 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Perilous
solution: The correct answer is "**Hazardous**" [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Let's look at the meaning of the given word. • **Perilous**: exposed to imminent risk of disaster or ruin. • Let's look at the meaning of the given options. • **Enormous: **very large in size, quantity, or extent. • **Populous: **having a large population; densely populated. • **Hazardous: **risky; dangerous. • **Tremendous: **very great in amount, scale, or intensity. • As per the meaning of the given words, "**hazardous**" is the synonym of "**perilous**". • **Example**: *The radioactive material should be handled with caution as its **hazardous **__to health.* Hence, the correct answer is **option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • Let's look at the meaning of the given word. • **Perilous**: आपदा या बर्बादी के आसन्न जोखिम के संपर्क में। • Let's look at the meaning of the given options. • **Enormous: ** आकार, मात्रा या सीमा में बहुत बड़ा। • **Populous: ** एक बड़ी आबादी वाले; घनी आबादी। • **Hazardous: ** जोखिम भरा; खतरनाक। • **Tremendous: ** मात्रा, पैमाने या तीव्रता में बहुत बढ़िया। • As per the meaning of the given words, "**hazardous**" is the synonym of "**perilous**". 41:T969, The erroneous spelling is "**Fruad**"
